# `get_img_thumbnail`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

File channel: read a stored image's thumbnail from disk and return it.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, imager file table (serves 4801), handler @0x1f4ea0 (64-bit build), @0x184288 (32-bit build); static analysis of app 3.3.2, RemotePhotoEntity command builder; FillPath, IsDir, GetFileFolderThbnlName (folder case), Load into a request-local IMG_DATA, reponse_result; jrpc_error with err_code/get_err_string on path errors |

File-channel (4801) method. Resolves `name` under the image root and returns the stored thumbnail of the file, or the folder's thumbnail when `name` is a folder, read into a request-local buffer. A missing or invalid path gives a text error carrying the current error code. READ. Filesystem read only: PURE GETTER / tier B. The 32-bit build matches (READ), apart from log wording.

Side effects: Resolves a request path, checks whether it is a folder, reads the stored thumbnail from disk into a request-local buffer, then responds. Filesystem read only; no write. READ; the 32-bit build matches (READ). The pure-getter grade stays probable.

Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_img_thumbnail"`. [READ] |
